title.narrative: Factor[e] Ventures - Catalyzing an Evergreen Impact Trust

description.narrative:
Norad supports Factor[e]'s work as a risk-embracing impact investor which accelerates innovative companies to drive the shift to an equitable, low-carbon economy, transform lives and generate economic returns. Using a unique approach of deep technical thesis-based investing, actively brokering new technologies, and hands-on venture building at the seed stage, Factor[e] spurs innovation in sustainable energy, agriculture, mobility, and water solutions. The project activities consist of two main tracks. It will firstly build a knowledge base through the work of Factor[e] Labs and secondly build new climate tech companies through the work of Factor[e] Ventures. Labs conducts non-competitive work that benefits the sector, emphasising research and development in sectors related to climate. This aims to build an accessible knowledge base around specific problems in advancing renewable energy and other climate technology and solutions in developing countries. Meanwhile, Ventures leverages the research conducted in the labs to make informed investments, oversee portfolio companies, and deliver hands-on support for the success of emerging technologies. In addition to investing in these companies itself, Factor[e] supports them in attracting further financing for scale. The parts of the programme supported by Norad will focus exclusively on companies and technologies directly related to renewable energy: increased generation, access and/or productive use.
As Factor[e] focuses on innovative business models and technologies it contributes to strengthening local private sector ecosystems, bringing in new technology and increased commercial financing. With a potential focus on companies working at the intersection of energy and food security, these investments may also contribute to strengthening local adaptation to the consequences of climate change.
